items.title: Bose Unveils Sport Open and Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) for Open-Ear Listening
items.summary: Bose announced two open-ear models on September 17: the Sport Open Earbuds at $199 with an IP54 C-arm cuff for workouts, and the Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) at $299 with deeper bass, Cinema Mode and a wireless charging case. Both ship October 1 and target users who want ambient awareness over noise isolation.

items.title: Omdia: Global TWS Shipments Dip 0.7% in Q2 2026 While Open-Ear Grows 12%
items.summary: Omdia reports Q2 2026 true wireless stereo shipments fell 0.7% year over year to 82.1 million units, the first annual decline since 2023. Open wireless stereo products grew 12% to 11.1 million units, now 13.5% of the market, with clip-on designs making up 61% of OWS volume.

items.title: Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 Launches in India with User-Replaceable Batteries
items.summary: Sennheiser brought the MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 to India at Rs 29,990, featuring 7mm TrueResponse drivers, Bluetooth 6.0, aptX Lossless and Dolby Atmos. The headline differentiator is user-replaceable batteries in both earbuds and the case, aimed at longer-term ownership. Sales began October 1.

items.title: OnePlus Nord Buds 3r Adds Jade Mist Color Ahead of India Festive Sales
items.summary: OnePlus expanded the Nord Buds 3r lineup in India with a Jade Mist finish, available from October 8 at Rs 1,999 (Rs 1,599 during festive promotions). The TWS earbuds offer 12.4mm titanium-coated drivers, 54-hour battery life, Bluetooth 5.4, AI translation and 47ms low-latency gaming mode.

items.title: Fairphone Fairbuds 2 Teased for October 14 Launch with LDAC and Seven Replaceable Parts
items.summary: Fairphone will launch the Fairbuds 2 on October 14 at $119 in the US after a European release, down from the original Fairbuds' 149 euro debut. The ultra-repairable wireless earbuds add improved Bluetooth and LDAC hi-res support, with seven replaceable parts including the in-ear batteries.

items.title: Apple AirPods Pro 3 Add On-Bud Heart Rate Sensor and Live Translation
items.summary: The AirPods Pro 3 upgrade Apple's flagship earbuds with a built-in heart-rate sensor for workout tracking, on-device Live Translation across more than 10 languages, and ANC claimed to be twice as strong as the previous generation. They offer 8 hours of battery with ANC on, five ear-tip sizes and IP57 resistance at $249.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy Buds4 Pro Review: Refined Sound and Stronger ANC for Galaxy Users
items.summary: The Galaxy Buds4 Pro pair a two-way speaker with 24-bit Hi-Fi audio over Bluetooth 6.1, adaptive ANC 2.0 and 360 Audio at about $249. Reviewers praise detailed warm-leaning sound and improved fit, though battery stays at 6 hours with ANC on and key AI features require a Galaxy device.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Dual Processors and 8-Mic Array Set the ANC Benchmark
items.summary: Sony's flagship WF-1000XM6 earbuds pair a new QN3e HD noise-cancelling processor with the Integrated Processor V2, eight adaptive microphones and a slimmer 8.4mm-driver chassis. Reviewers call them the all-rounder to beat for noise cancelling, sound and call clarity, with LDAC support and about 8 hours of battery.

items.title: Shokz OpenDots ONE Review: Clip-On Open-Ear Fit for Runners and Glasses Wearers
items.summary: The Shokz OpenDots ONE are open-ear clip-on earbuds with Dolby Audio, dual drivers and OpenBass 2.0, weighing about 6.5g per bud with up to 40 hours of total battery and IP54 resistance. The review highlights secure interchangeable left-right fit and situational awareness, though open design offers no isolation for noisy commutes.

items.title: Nothing and CMF Audio Debut Ear (3a), Buds Pro 2 and Clip Pro in Nepal
items.summary: Chaudhary Group launched Nothing Ear (3a), CMF Buds Pro 2 and CMF Clip Pro in Nepal on September 27. The Ear (3a) adds Audio Snapshot and on-device call recording with up to 45dB ANC, the Buds Pro 2 bring a Smart Dial case and 50dB hybrid ANC, and the Clip Pro is an open-ear option, starting at NPR 8,599.
